definitions.gloss: Hakone; the mountain hot-spring resort southwest of Tokyo
definitions.explanation: A volcanic mountain area in Kanagawa Prefecture famous for its hot springs, its views of Mount Fuji across Lake Ashi, and its ryokan inns. It is the default answer when Tokyo residents think of a short onsen trip, and it hosts the New Year's Hakone Ekiden relay race.

examples.japanese: {箱根|はこね}の{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go to the hot springs in Hakone.

examples.japanese: {正月|しょうがつ}はテレビで{箱根|はこね}{駅伝|えきでん}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: At New Year's we watch the Hakone Ekiden on TV.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}がよければ、{箱根|はこね}から{芦|あし}ノ{湖|こ}{越|ご}しに{富士山|ふじさん}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: If the weather is good, you can see Mount Fuji from Hakone across Lake Ashi.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {箱根|はこね}{駅伝|えきでん}: the university relay race run every January 2nd and 3rd
- {箱根|はこね}{温泉|おんせん}: the Hakone hot springs
- {箱根|はこね}{越|ご}え: crossing the Hakone pass — historically the hardest stretch of the Tokaido road
- {箱根|はこね}{関所|せきしょ}: the Edo-period checkpoint at Hakone

CULTURAL NOTE:
Because the Hakone Ekiden is broadcast nationwide over the New Year holiday, {箱根|はこね} is tied to New Year viewing habits as much as to travel. Its steep pass also lives on in the old song line {箱根|はこね}の{山|やま}は{天下|てんか}の{険|けん} — "the mountains of Hakone are the steepest under heaven."
